summary: Specifies ways to configure DDoS Open Threat Signaling (DOTS) clients with their DOTS servers, including for the signal channel Call Home. Knowing the right server for a location helps a client ask for attack mitigation, even when it cannot tell where the attack is coming from.

eli5.summary: When your network is under attack, you need to know whom to call for help. This explains how devices automatically find the right helper.

questions: how does a dots client find its server
